tur: Short motivation films: one clumsy character, one habit, Day 1 vs Day 100 (stick-figure animation)
ozet: Mert is a clumsy but determined guy from Turkey. Each film follows one habit (phone, sleep, saving money) from a messy Day 1 to a calmer Day 100. Short, warm, funny and honest.
kurallar: No fake statistics, no income or health promises; the story is fictional and light.
Mert always fails in a funny way first, then improves a little; never mocks real people.
Natural English, short sentences, one idea per scene.
yazim: 6 scenes, 70-100 words, vertical Shorts. Day 1, a clumsy Day 3 or 10, Day 30, Day 100, then a closing question.

mert.kim: Clumsy, determined guy from Turkey with a mustache and an orange shirt.
